name: Advanced Conditional Shipping
author: Cloud Technologies

sections.installation:
Download the .zip file.
Go to: WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New and Upload Plugin with the file you downloaded with Choose File.
Install Now and Activate the extension.

You can also visit cloudtechnologiess.store
sections.changelog:
2025-3-04 – version 2.0.1
* Add – Added Condition to show /hide shipping method when X method is available.
* Add – Added Admin Can Create and Combine Shipping Methods.
* Add – Added Multiple Shipping Boxes per product.
* Fix – Multi Select load issue fixed.
* Fix – Fixed bug with country selection.
* Fix – Fixed bug with taxable condition.

2024-10-02 – version 1.1.0
* Add – Added option to enable/disable advanced conditions to existing shipping methods.
* Update – Update labels for shipping sections.

2024-09-27 – version 1.0.1
* Update – Compatibility update for WooCommerce cart and checkout blocks.

2023-05-18 – version 1.0.0
* Other – Initial release of the plugin.
sections.description:
WooCommerce Advanced Conditional Shipping is a powerful shipping management system that allows online merchants to customize their shipping rates and options based on various conditions. With this plugin, you can create and apply specific rules to ensure accurate and flexible shipping calculations.

Features

  • Add Rule Base Shipping
  • Add Combine Shipping Method
  • Remove Shipping Method
  • Filters available

Contact US

  • Feel free to contact us on for installation and customization
